descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S18 「稀疏和杂乱病程上的医院日期窗口：只有昨天和今天的行，没有补位行，没有更早的」 Hospital day window on sparse and messy ledgers: only yesterday's and today's lines, no filler, nothing older

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.6；TFA-92589 AC 4）
  • U2 A day the patient was not seen is legitimately absent: no entry and no filler line for it.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 description 2）
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Four seeded Hospital patients (server-clock labels). HA: '{day-3}' + '{day0}' (yesterday not seen). HB: only '{day-2}'. HC: only '{day-1}'. HD: an undated legacy line, '{day-5}', '{day-1}', '{day0}', and a '{day-3}' line typed by hand beneath today's

When Open each chart's Pre-Round tab (view only, editor closed)

Then HA: only today's card; no '{day-3}' card and no filler card for yesterday. HB: no cards. HC: just yesterday's card, nothing for today. HD: yesterday's card, then today's; the 5-days-ago and 3-days-ago lines are not on the cards; the undated line is Q6

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per patient, scoped to the Course Timeline. This is what tells the 'yesterday and today' window (U3) from a 'two most recent dated lines' build, the bug class of the 2026-10-02 rejection ('last 3 lines'): such a build shows '{day-3}' for HA and '{day-2}' for HB. HA/HC also prove a day not seen stays absent with no filler (U2, Hospital). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
